lines.text: Many learners say: I make homework every day.
Better: I do homework every day.

native.tip: Уроки не “make”, а “do”: “I do homework every day”.
native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “I make homework every day.”? 😅 По-русски «делать уроки» — одно слово, а в английском homework идёт с “do”. Правильно: “I do homework every day.”. Послушай Ама и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.
native.comment: Ответ: “do”. Homework — это do. Бесплатный тест для практики здесь: {link}

en.tip: Homework is “do”, not “make”: “I do homework every day”.
en.caption: Do you also say “I make homework every day.”? 😅 Russian has one word “delat'”, but English homework goes with “do”. Correct: “I do homework every day.”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
